title: cert-add --label lookup rejects keys created externally
description: cmd_keystore_cert_add in src/cli/wp11_cli.c applies is_valid_label() to the by_label argument, which is used to *find* an existing key (not create one). If a keystore was created programmatically (via the API, not the CLI) with a label containing bytes outside the CLI validator's range, the user cannot attach a certificate to that key using cert-add. The validator is correct for creation sites (cmd_keystore_create, cmd_keystore_import_key) but over-restrictive for lookup sites. Fix: remove the is_valid_label() call from cmd_keystore_cert_add. Replace with a non-empty check only.
